summary: Allow SQLite WAL restart during mail objective captures and bound recapture frequency

replay.detail: No claim, projection or replay changes.

rules.detail: Mail acceptance, unknown coverage and source freshness semantics are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Mail-delivery objectives read retained source metadata in indexed 128-row pages without a scan-wide snapshot, allowing WAL restart during capture. Change signals coalesce until at least 60 seconds after the preceding capture ends, bounding retained-history recomputation on busy daemons. Canonical identity references are resolved once per distinct spelling within each capture. Pending changes and captures overlapping graph claims publish unknown coverage rather than certifying stale or mixed observations. Idle heartbeat and lifecycle boundary timers remain active.

downtime.detail: Takes effect on daemon restart; no migration required.
